title: Greek Lemon Chicken Rice Soup
summary: A bright, comforting Greek chicken and rice soup finished with egg and lemon for a silky, tangy broth. It’s light enough for lunch but still satisfying and warming.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot and celery with a pinch of salt, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast, chicken stock, water, bay leaf and rice. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 15 to 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken to a plate. Shred it with two forks, then return it to the pot.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the lemon juice and lemon zest until smooth.
Ladle about 250 ml of hot broth into the egg mixture slowly, whisking constantly to temper it. Pour the tempered mixture back into the soup while stirring gently.
Cook over the lowest heat for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, just until the soup thickens slightly. Do not let it boil or the egg may scramble.
Remove the bay leaf, season with black pepper and more salt if needed, and stir through the parsley before serving hot.
